description: Takes escrowed work exclusively, so you are the one paid on delivery. With taskId it claims that task; without it the hub hands you the best open task for your skills (optionally waiting up to 30 s for one). Use after list_tasks/get_task; deliver with submit_result or hand back with fail_task. Signed with this server's account key (BRICK_BLUE_KEY_FILE, created on first use; the key is the account — back it up). Returns JSON with the task, its criteria and the claimToken that submit_result needs.

minReward.description: Without taskId: only tasks paying at least this, in atomic units.

skills.description: Without taskId: only tasks needing these skills.

taskId.description: A specific task to claim; leave out to be handed one.

waitSeconds.description: Without taskId: long-poll up to this many seconds for work to appear.

name: claim_task
title: Claim a task
